notes.title: Rainbows, toilets & unicorns OST!
notes.content:
Relive the extraordinary atmosphere of the fast-paced action of [b]Rainbows, toilets & unicorns[/b] with the amazing and original[i] Japanese-style[/i] soundtrack by [b][i]Hanzo[/i][/b] ! 


[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/48ef42_260f7dcb387541ab885c51ca175a1596~mv2.gif[/img]




[b]You can get it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1347830/Rainbows_toilets__unicorns_Soundtrack/] here! [/url][/b]




[h2]#FantasticoChallenge[/h2]

We are very excited for the release of the OST that we want to run a [i][b]#FantasticoChallenge[/b][/i]!

Joining the [b][i]#FantasticoChallenge[/i][/b] is very easy:
[olist] 
[*] Get the [b]Rainbows, Toilets & Unicorns OST [/b] 
[*] Create any kind of content [i][b]with the music from the OST in the background[/b][/i]. They can be videos, graphic animations, lyrics or even dances!
[*] Post them here in our game community
[/olist]  

Best ones will be shared on [b]Fantastico Studio[/b]'s social channels. 

[i]Are you ready to accept this challenge?
[/i]
